_meta.description: Deterministic severity model anchored on OWASP AIVSS v0.8. Severity is computed from code-derivable factors PLUS documented defaults for agentic/AARS factors that are not derivable from static code. The score is deterministic given these defaults; reports state which factors were derived vs defaulted.

sink_reachability.description: Does untrusted/model-controlled data reach a dangerous sink (exec/eval/shell/SQL/deserialize/render)?

external_comms.description: Can the component send data to an external destination?

data_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of data reachable by the component.

defaulted_aars_factors._note: Not statically derivable. Pinned defaults make scoring deterministic; reports flag these as 'defaulted'.

severity_bands._note: Final numeric score in [0,10] = base_weight(rule) * (0.4*max(code_factors) + 0.3*mean(code_factors) + 0.3*aars_component). Bands map score -> label.

rule_base_weights._note: Per-rule starting weight by the primary OWASP risk class; a rule may override.
